Love for clear signage
Winter has been kind to the desk
Small wins for pet travel

The Companion Animal Travel Desk at Aurelia Skyways has had a steady stretch, and the mood around the counters is bright. Travel days feel smoother when the welfare coordinator checks comfort needs early, the ground team handles carriers with care, and the desk keeps its guidance clear for families and flyers alike. <<FACT F047>> The result is a calmer handoff and more confident travelers, whether they are sending off a seasoned companion or arriving with a first-timer.

We have also seen a nice rhythm in the way questions are coming in, with staff answering in a warm, practical tone that helps everyone settle in fast. <<FACT F040>> That kind of steady support matters, because small details add up when pets are on the move. Keep the updates coming, keep the signage easy to follow, and keep the welcome friendly. Companion Animal Travel Desk
